fusions.name: Horn-Curve Toss
fusions.desc: Hooks under the target and tosses it for 14 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Back Into the Mowing
fusions.desc: Cuts a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 9 damage to everything in it. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Fresh-Cut Fodder
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Hay in the Loft
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regain 0.5 health a second.
